results.content: p/nvidiaThe official handle for NVIDIA. NVIDIA CUDA 13.1 introduces the largest and most comprehensive update to the CUDA platform since it was invented two decades ago. ### Project G-Assist - On-GPU AI, built for the game. Project G-Assist is an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune and optimize your system. ### NVIDIA Chat with RTX - Build a localized, personal AI chatbot. Chat With RTX is a demo app that lets you personalize a GPT large language model (LLM) connected to your own content—docs, notes, videos, or other data. ### NVIDIA Edify 3D - Scalable High-Quality 3D Asset Generation. Using text and images as descriptions, developers and visual content creators can use NVIDIA Edify 3D to quickly generate 3D objects to create virtual worlds and prototype ideas. ### Evo 2 - A foundation model for genomic understanding. Evo 2, a powerful biomolecular AI model, provides insights into DNA, RNA and proteins across diverse species. ### NVIDIA Jetson Nano - Bringing the power of modern AI to millions of devices. NVIDIA Jetson Nano enables the development of millions of new small, low-power AI systems. ### NVLM 1.0 - Open frontier-class multimodal LLMs. A family of frontier-class multimodal large language models (LLMs) that achieve state-of-the-art results on vision-language tasks, rivaling the leading proprietary models (e.g., GPT-4o) and open-access models (e.g., Llama 3-V 405B and InternVL 2). ### NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1 - Open Foundation Model for Humanoids. NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1 is the open foundation model for humanoid robots. ### Nvidia Blackwell B200 GPU - The world’s most powerful chip’ for AI. 30 times performance increase for LLM inference workloads and can scale to AI models with up to 10 trillion parameters. ### Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit - Most affordable generative AI supercomputer. Introducing the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit, offering up to 67 TOPS of AI performance for $249. ### Productivity. ### AI Agents. ### Trending products. * POLL: Domain or product first? * YC deadline in <2 weeks; Who's applying? * We Got into YC, Got Kicked Out, and Fought Our Way Back.
